verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the screenshot guide's mention of handling "target headers". That suggests custom headers, possibly including a Cookie header, can be sent to the target site, but only for screenshots. Nothing documents session-cookie passthrough or authenticated-page fetching for Scrape, Crawl or Extract. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cookie or session passthrough, support on scrape/crawl/extract endpoints, examples of fetching login-gated pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
